system.description:
This trait is only available to biomorphs. This morph has substantial physiological and genetic differences from human morphs. Level 1 applies to non-human morphs. Level 2 applies to non-mammalian morphs. Apply a –10 modifier per level to Medicine Tests. Certain drugs, toxin, chemicals, or medical procedures may not work or may have a different effect (GM discretion). This trait may not be applied
to morphs that do not come with it.
